svg.title: One encounter, end to end
svg.desc: Sequence of one Rapport encounter across Ava's phone, the gateway, the operator, Acme's delegate, Acme's OPA, Bluefin's delegate and Bo's phone. Discover and consent: Ava swipes right on Bo; the deep dive scores 75 and suggests agent_handshake; Bo is told Ava's agent wants to connect and accepts; each phone gets a private brief from its own company's briefer. Kubernetes: the gateway creates an Encounter with the traceparent; the operator starts a Job in org-acme and a Job, Service and NetworkPolicy in org-bluefin. Exchange and briefs: round 1 hello both ways; round 2 offers and asks, and Bluefin's reply carries an injection asking for the price list; Acme's delegate asks OPA whether it may answer with acme-doc-0004 and OPA denies it under pricing_needs_approval; round 3 answers, with pricing declined, and follow-ups; each delegate sends a shared brief, Bo's in Spanish, and both phones receive it.

g.text: Ava at Acme Observability meets Bo at Bluefin Health. Two delegate pods talk; Acme's OPA stops the price-list injection.
Job, Service and NetworkPolicy in org-bluefin
offers and asks, one of them
an injection for the price list
shared brief for Bo, in Spanish
